config.experience_obliterator.title: Experience Obliterator
config.experience_obliterator.option.dis: Disables the spawning of experience orbs in the world.
Disables the visual rendering of experience orbs.
config.experience_obliterator.option.imm: Automatically awards experience orbs to the nearest player upon spawn.
config.experience_obliterator.option.hid: Removes the experience bar from the HUD.
Removes the experience level number from the HUD.
Hides the green progress fill of the experience bar, leaving the empty bar background visible.
config.experience_obliterator.option.rem: Removes the 'Too Expensive!' limit for anvils, allowing you to perform operations regardless of the level cost.
config.experience_obliterator.option.no_: Sets the experience cost for combining enchantments (via books or items) to 0.
Sets the experience cost for all anvil repairs (using materials or combining damaged items) to 0.
Sets the experience cost for all anvil renames to 0.
config.experience_obliterator.option.dis: Disables right-click interaction with Enchanting Tables.
Mutes the experience orb pickup sound effect.
Mutes the experience level-up sound effect.
Removes the hardcoded experience tooltip from Echo Chests, if it is installed.
